newsitem.title: USA: United Tech sees earnings up 15 pct in '97.
newsitem.headline: United Tech sees earnings up 15 pct in '97.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said on Wednesday it expected earnings to grow by 15 percent in 1997.
"We liked our 21 percent earnings increase in the (third) quarter and continuing excellent cash flow," it said. "These confirm our momentum to generate a further 15 percent earnings gain next year."
The company, which provides high-technology products and services to the automotive and aerospace industries, reported earnings per share of $1.94 for the third quarter, up from $1.60 a year earlier.
It said four of its five operating segments achieved double-digit percentage gains in operating profit in the quarter, led by Flight Systems and Pratt & Whitney.
Pratt's improvement reflected higher aftermarket sales and continued cost reductions and productivity improvements, it said.
Its Carrier unit benefited from strong demand for residential and light commercial air conditioning in North America, it said.
Automotive's operating profit improved in the seasonally weak third quarter as increased profitability in Europe and higher sales volumes more than offset weakness in the interiors business, it said.
Prior to the impact of foreign currency translation and charges to reduce the workforce in Europe, the Otis unit's operating income increased 10 percent in the quarter, it said.
